answer: Honeypot canaries resist sybil grading rings: among real challenges the system seeds answers known to be bad, a fable dressed as fact. An honest grader fails them; a colluding ring that rubber-stamps its own members approves the trap and unmasks itself. The seeded answer is an oasis that only mirages — no haven for a ring. Graders who pass canaries lose standing, so cross-approval collusion carries a detection cost no large ring can hide.
